name: lemonslice
description: Add a LemonSlice video avatar to a LiveKit voice agent, or build one from scratch.

interface.longDescription: LemonSlice turns any single image into a real-time, lip-synced video avatar that joins your LiveKit room as a participant. This plugin teaches ChatGPT and Codex to attach the avatar to an existing LiveKit agent in Python or Node.js, or to scaffold a complete app from the LemonSlice starter: API keys, the voice cascade, the ringing UI, and optionally CWM-1 so the character reacts and emotes during the call.
capabilities: Attach a LemonSlice avatar to a LiveKit agent
defaultPrompt: Add a LemonSlice video avatar to my LiveKit agent.
Build a talking avatar app on LiveKit from scratch.
Make my avatar wave when the call starts.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: LiveKit integration skill with CWM-1 and session control.
